name: Mothers Day
overview: Scripture honors the sacred role of mothers, emphasizing the divine blessing of children as a heritage from the Lord and a reward from the womb (Psalms 127:3). God's intimate involvement in our formation is seen in His care even within the mother's womb (Psalms 139:13). The Bible commands honoring our parents, including mothers, promising longevity in the land God gives (Exodus 20:12), and highlights the importance of heeding a mother's instruction (Proverbs 1:8) and training children in godly ways (Proverbs 22:6). God's unfailing compassion mirrors that of a mother’s love, assuring us He will never forget His people (Isaiah 49:15).
